status_note: Pool registration purity projection MATCH: the locked Ghidra 12.0.4 oracle (real ActionDatabase::universalAction -> resetDefaults -> union-grouplist derive + decompile derive) and Rugra's real default action database produce byte-identical rule registration sequences for all three ActionPools (oppool1: 134 rules, oppool2: 5, cleanup: 15), in both the full-union derive of the raw registration site and the production decompile derive. The former Rugra-local registrations are gone: no 'sexteliminate' (no oracle class anywhere), no 'equality' (oracle class ruleaction.hh:243 never instantiated), and 'trivialarith' appears exactly once per root at oppool1 index 10 (coreaction.cc:5522 slot), never in cleanup. Rule diagnostic names are observed through the oracle's public virtual ActionPool::print and normalized by deleting '_' (injective on both sides' name sets); the one pre-existing raw-name defect this exposed (oracle 'threewaycomp' vs former Rugra 'three_way_compare') was fixed to the oracle string. Registered non-observed domains remain in coverage as NO_ORACLE/UNTESTED and are bound to their residual TODO ids.

decisive_semantics.reference_output_parameters: No output parameters: the pool rule sequence is the shared observable. Oracle side reads it through the PUBLIC virtual ActionPool::print(s,num,depth) (action.cc:753-775), which iterates the private allrules vector in registration order — the same listing the console's printActionList surfaces; Rugra side reads ActionPool::rules() (registration-order slice, action.rs). The raw registration site is reached on the oracle through a public setGroup("all", union-of-default-groups) + setCurrent("all") derive (ActionPool::clone appends surviving rules in allrules order, action.cc:899-914) and on Rugra through get_action("universal").
decisive_semantics.loop_bounds_traversal_order: DFS is pre-order over each ActionGroup child list in registration order; every ActionPool emits its rules as a unit in allrules/addRule order (vector begin()->end(), action.hh:263 / action.rs add_rule push). Duplicate pools across the two roots are kept verbatim with no sort or dedup: root=all block lines 2-158, root=decompile block lines 160-316, and the two blocks must be equal.
decisive_semantics.counter_accumulator_lifecycle: The only counters are the per-pool rule index (0-based, increments once per rule line, resets at each pool) and the rule count printed on the pool line (equals the number of rule lines that follow); there is no cross-pool accumulator.
decisive_semantics.sorting_comparison_keys: No sorting or comparison is applied anywhere in the observation; rule order is exactly the addRule registration order produced by universalAction (coreaction.cc:5512-5646/5664-5669/5696-5710). Name normalization deletes '_' characters only (oracle 'threewaycomp'/'collect_terms' vs Rugra 'three_way_compare'/'collect_terms' conventions); it is injective on both sides' full rule-name sets, so no two distinct rules can collide.

analysis_options.all_groups_union: setGroup("all") = union of the six buildDefaultGroups member arrays (coreaction.cc:5424-5456)

inputs.ghidra_fixture_architecture: FixtureArchitecture/FixtureTranslate (spaces: constant/other/unique/ram/register/stack/join/iop); pool rule names read through the public virtual ActionPool::print (action.cc:753-775)
inputs.rugra_entry: ActionDatabase::set_default_actions -> get_action("universal") + get_current; ActionPool::rules() registration view

pool_rule_projection.covers: All three pools' full registration sequences identical on both sides and across both roots: oppool1 134 rules ending at doubleout (coreaction.cc:5646; the extra_pool_rules loop at 5647-5649 absorbs zero CPU-specific rules for the fixture Architecture), oppool2 5 rules (5664-5669, the commented RuleIndirectConcat line 5667 is not a registration), cleanup 15 rules ending at stringstore (5696-5710). No sexteliminate (class absent from the entire locked tree), no equality (ruleaction.hh:243 class never instantiated anywhere), trivialarith exactly once per root at oppool1 index 10, never in cleanup.

rule_name_projection.covers: Every rule diagnostic name identical after the documented underscore-deletion normalization (injective on both sides' name sets). The pre-existing raw-name defect this fixture exposed — oracle 'threewaycomp' (ruleaction.hh:1504) vs former Rugra 'three_way_compare' — was fixed to the exact oracle string in this change.

raw_rule_name_strings.covers: Exact raw diagnostic name strings (oracle 'trivialarith' vs Rugra 'trivial_arith', 'collect_terms' on both, etc.) are compared only through the underscore-free normalization; a raw-string equality sweep across all ~154 rule names is outside this fixture's projection.

rule_behavior_bodies.covers: Rule applyOp bodies, getOpList opcode dispatch sets, per-rule counters (count_tests/count_apply) and pool application dynamics are outside this fixture's domain; only registration membership and order are observed.

cpu_extra_pool_rules.covers: The conf->extra_pool_rules absorption loop (coreaction.cc:5647-5649) has no oracle observation here: the fixture Architecture registers no CPU-specific rules, and Rugra has no extra_pool_rules channel yet (x86-64 gcc spec registers none in the oracle either).
